sentences.text: 2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant-accused involved in Case Crime No.13 of 2023, under Section 376 IPC, P.S.Kairana, District Shamli with the prayer to enlarge him on bail.

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant-accused that applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Referring to first information report and statement of prosecutrix, recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it was submitted that there are material contradictions in her statement.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix has inter-alia stated that applicant has been apprehended by the public persons at the spot, whereas, the record clearly shows that applicant was arrested by the police on the next day of incident.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Referring to statement of prosecutrix, it was submitted that the attending facts and Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/63649019/
1 circumstances of the case show that the allegations of rape made against applicant are wholly false.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix is a mature and married lady having four children.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that in fact earlier the applicant has lodged a non-cognizable report on 29.03.2022 against the distant relative of the husband of informant and that the first information report of this case has been lodged due to that reason, making false and baseless allegations of rape.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Regarding criminal history of applicant, it was submitted that in that case, police have found that applicant was not involved in that case and final report was submitted in favour of applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: It was further submitted that applicant-accused is languishing in jail since 11.01.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and cooperate in the trial.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 4. Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the first informant have opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the prosecutrix has made clear and categorical statement that while she was going along with her two children, she has taken lift in the car of applicant and thereafter, he took her to a room and committed rape upon her.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It was submitted that there are absolutely no reasons for false implication of applicant and that there is no contradictions in the statement in the prosecutrix,
recorded under Section 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: The independent witnesses have also stated that prosecutrix has taken lift in the car of applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: 5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, gravity of offence and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, at this stage, no case for bail is made out.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, the bail application of applicant-accused is hereby rejected.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 19 May, 2023.json

sentences.text: This is the second bail application moved on behalf of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: Criminal Misc. First Bail
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: Application No. 53995 of 2023 has been rejected by this Court vide order dated 17.01.2023.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: 2.Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: 3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text:
Learned counsel further submits that by the efflux of time, trial began in which the charges were framed on 13.02.2023 and thereafter summons were issued to the witness but they are not appearing before the trial and are no co-operating in the trial,
which is evident from the perusal of order sheets of the case, copy of the order sheets of the case till 19.11.2024 has been annexed as Annexure-SA1 to the supplementary affidavit and certified copy of Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125281303/
1 the order sheets of the case with effect from 24.10.2024 to 21.02.2025 has been produced before this Court and is marked as "X" and is kept on record.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: Several other submissions in order to demonstrate the falsity of the allegations made against the applicant have also been placed before the Court.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: The circumstances which, according to the counsel, led to the false implication of the accused have also been mentioned.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: It has also been assured on behalf of the applicant that he is ready to cooperate with the process of law and shall faithfully make himself available before the court whenever required and is also ready to accept all the conditions which the Court may deem fit to impose upon him.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: He next submits that applicant is languishing in jail since 11.08.2022 having no criminal history.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: 4. Per contra, learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text:
5. After perusing the record in the light of the submissions made at the bar and after taking an overall view of all the facts and circumstances of this case, the nature of evidence and also the absence of any convincing material to indicate the possibility of tampering with the evidence,
without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this Court is of the view, that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: Hence the bail application is allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

A. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
B. The applicant shall not pressurize/ intimidate the prosecution witness.
C. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: E. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
sentences._hearing_file: Shahjad vs State Of U.P. on 8 July, 2025.json

sentences.text: 7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the trial Court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of the applicant in accordance with law.
